newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian peso ends weaker on strike speculation.
newsitem.headline: Colombian peso ends weaker on strike speculation.

text.p: Colombia's peso fell 3.7 pesos against the dollar to 1,074.5 in markets driven by speculation about the implications of the state workers' strike due to begin at midnight Monday/0500 GMT, interbank traders said.
"Part of today's peso drop was on the back of the news that talks to avert the strike had broken down over the weekend," one trader said.

Demand for greenbacks from industry was low, but some banks were buying to build up forward dollar positions. Dealers said there was only a slight influx of dollars from traditional export sectors such as coffee and oil.
The peso opened at 1,073.5, hit an intraday high of 1,073 and hit a low of 1,077.
Dealers reported 461 trades worth a total $198 million. Most signaled that the dollar would continue to rise on the back of speculation through much of Tuesday's session.
